name: collaborare
description: A shared, auditable Copilot Chat participant backed by project Markdown conversations.

chatParticipants.name: collaborare
chatParticipants.description: Ask Copilot with shared project conversation context

commands.name: open
commands.description: Open the project knowledge database folder

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check the project knowledge database status

commands.name: account
commands.description: Select the GitHub Copilot account name for audit logs

collaborare.projectPath.description: Project root. Relative paths are resolved from the first workspace folder. When empty, the first workspace folder is used.

collaborare.knowledgeDirectory.description: Relative directory under the project root used for shared knowledge. Absolute paths and traversal segments are rejected.

collaborare.accountName.description: GitHub Copilot account name written to audit logs. Stored only in this VM's user settings. When empty, Collaborare detects GitHub accounts and asks for a selection if needed.

collaborare.maxKnowledgeFiles.description: Maximum Markdown file count for one recursive knowledge scan. Exceeding it blocks the model request.

collaborare.maxContextChars.description: Maximum character budget shared by retrieved knowledge and participant history.

collaborare.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 byte size of an individual Markdown knowledge file.

collaborare.maxKnowledgeBytes.description: Maximum aggregate byte size loaded during one shared knowledge scan. An incomplete byte-limited scan blocks the model request.

collaborare.topK.description: Maximum number of relevant knowledge files added to a model request.

collaborare.localSpoolEnabled.description: Queue a conversation in VS Code local extension storage when the shared drive cannot publish it, then retry on the next request or sync command.

collaborare.localSpoolMaxFiles.description: Maximum number of pending conversation logs retained in this VM.

collaborare.localSpoolMaxBytes.description: Maximum aggregate byte size of pending conversation logs retained in this VM.
